summary: GRAPHITE-01 phase 3 now reads the real phase-2 literature; it is built without spend, and no live session has run. A live phase-3 run must name a frozen phase-2 snapshot with --literature-snapshot and refuses to start without one; only the dry run still serves the synthetic fixture, and its session record says so. The session record pins the snapshot file's digest, the offer policy and every offered card, and a resume with another snapshot or policy is refused before anything runs. Snapshots now record each card's check status. By default a session is offered only cards a person checked CORRECT; --allow-unchecked-cards adds unchecked cards, marked UNCHECKED in every tool result and in the session record. With no checked card the index is empty, and the record and status say so: nothing falls back to the fixture. Protected cards stay withheld. The Constructor's brief lists the offered card ids, because it holds lit_card only. The Planner gains a closed tool, graphite_propose_next_level, which stores a typed PROPOSED record when a card points at a capability outside the recorded battery construction contract. The record cites the contract dimension and entry, its source cards and what Carbon would need to reconstruct the capability; phase3 proposals lists the records and a run's bundle carries its own. A proposal never widens the contract, never records an expansion, never changes a permission or tool and never reaches a score; widening a level stays the owner's decision under the reconstruction rule. Scripted tests and mutation checks cover each protection. Nothing here grades, qualifies or rewards.
